map.小朋友学写字，照着静态笔顺列表逐笔临摹「永」「学」「想」等已收录字，建立正确的起: Children learning to write can copy the characters 永, 学 and 想 stroke by stroke from the static list, building correct starting, moving and ending order and avoiding reversed strokes.
map.成年人练书法或硬笔字，核对易错字笔顺（如「我」第五笔为斜钩、「想」先写木字旁再写: Adults practicing calligraphy or penmanship can check error-prone stroke orders (e.g. the fifth stroke of 我 is a slant hook; 想 writes the wood radical first, then 目, then 心), correcting long-standing mistakes.
map.对外汉语教学中向留学生演示汉字笔顺，配合笔画名称讲解，降低识记难度、符合规范书写: In teaching Chinese as a foreign language, demonstrate stroke order to international students with stroke-name explanations, lowering memorization difficulty and meeting standard-writing requirements.
map.演示「永」字八法笔顺: Demonstrate the stroke order of yong (the Eight Principles of Yong)
map.输入「永」（5 画）：按列表依次显示 点→横折钩→横撇→撇→捺，对应「永字八法」: Input 永 (5 strokes): the list shows dot → horizontal-turning-hook → horizontal-left-falling → left-falling → right-falling, the basic strokes of the Eight Principles of Yong; input 学 (8 strokes) to compare dot, dot, left-falling, dot, horizontal hook and so on. This tool is a static list and does not play animations.
map.笔顺依据什么规范？: Which standard defines the stroke order?
map.依据《现代汉语通用字笔顺规范》与通用书写习惯，覆盖常用规范汉字；生僻字或异体字可: Based on the Standard Stroke Order of Commonly Used Characters in Modern Chinese and common writing habits, covering common standard characters; rare or variant characters may be absent.
map.页面会播放笔顺动画吗？: Does the page play stroke-order animations?
map.不会。本工具只提供静态笔顺文字列表，便于复制与打印；若需动画演示可参考字帖或书法: No. The tool provides only a static stroke-order text list for easy copying and printing; for animated demonstrations see copybooks or calligraphy apps.
map.笔顺和笔画数对不上字典怎么办？: What if the stroke order or count disagrees with the dictionary?
map.先确认输入的是规范简体字；若涉及繁体或异体写法，笔顺可能不同，可切换对应字形再查: First confirm you entered the standard simplified character; if a traditional or variant form is involved, the stroke order may differ — switch to the corresponding glyph and look it up again.
map.未收录笔顺，可先按拼音/部首分解辅助书写。: stroke order is not in the database; split the character by pinyin or radical to help with writing.
map.提示：本工具输出静态笔顺文字列表；真实笔顺依字形字体可能存在差异，结果供学习参考: Note: this tool outputs a static stroke-order text list; actual stroke order may differ with typeface, so use the result as a study reference.
